title: report
body:
## report

Join tables, filter with null-aware named conditions, derive values, group and aggregate, rank with windows, combine selects and publish an exact, deterministically ordered result as JSON and typed CSV. Every native row is compared with an independent reference computed from the same declared inputs.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Comparisons with NULL are unknown, and rows are kept only when a condition is TRUE.
- Ties across a limit/offset boundary, or under row-number and running windows, are refused instead of published in arbitrary order.

Native binding: `SELECT JOIN/WHERE/GROUP BY/HAVING/UNION/analytic functions/ORDER BY/FETCH`. Output kind: `["table","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
